episodes.synopsis: Abducted by modern-day pirates and declared dead by his company, businessman Rokuro Okajima joins his captors on their ship, the Black Lagoon.
episodes.title: The Black Lagoon

episodes.synopsis: Rock devises a plan to destroy the gunship that seems to have trapped the Black Lagoon. Meanwhile, the Lagoon Company accepts Rock as a new member.
episodes.title: Mangrove Heaven

episodes.synopsis: A gangster named Chin lures Dutch and the crew of the Black Lagoon into a battle at sea against Luak, the leader of rival pirates.
episodes.title: Ring-Ding Ship Chase

episodes.synopsis: While on a mission to retrieve a valuable painting from a sunken U-boat, the Black Lagoon is besieged by missile-firing neo-Nazis.
episodes.title: Die Rückkehr des Adlers

episodes.synopsis: After finding the painting on the sunken sub, Rock and Revy argue over looking for more loot while the neo-Nazis' own divers approach the wreck.
episodes.title: Eagle Hunting and Hunting Eagles

episodes.synopsis: Dutch and Revy's violent raid on the neo-Nazi ship leads to surprising revelations about Revy and the Black Lagoon's mission to recover the painting.
episodes.title: Moonlit Hunting Grounds

episodes.synopsis: Revy's resentment at being sent on assignment with Rock may change when he calms a potentially volatile situation with a dealer.
episodes.title: Calm Down, Two Men

episodes.synopsis: The Black Lagoon crew must deliver a young hostage to a Colombian cartel, but Dutch has a crisis of conscience when he learns the boy's identity.
episodes.title: Rasta Blasta

episodes.synopsis: The Black Lagoon crew discovers too late that Roberta is a formidable opponent with a price on her head, as they attempt to flee with Garcia.
episodes.title: Maid to Kill

episodes.synopsis: Rock learns the truth about Balalaika's troops when they intervene in a no-holds-barred confrontation between Revy and Roberta.
episodes.title: The Unstoppable Chambermaid

episodes.synopsis: While transporting information on a terrorist organization to the CIA, the Black Lagoon crew comes under attack by the terrorists.
episodes.title: Lock 'n Load Revolution

episodes.synopsis: Rock learns the truth about Takenaka while under interrogation, and gets an even bigger surprise after he's rescued by Revy and Shenhua.
episodes.title: Guerrillas in the Jungle
